facts.P1_fx_receipts: Yes, freely; EU rules ban restrictions on payments.
facts.P2_fcy_account: Yes: banks like BCR open foreign-currency current accounts for individuals.
facts.P3_local_gateways: Local gateways not researched yet; see the services listed above.
facts.L1_registration: Register a PFA at the trade register (ONRC), online or in person, before starting.
facts.L2_tax_id: Your CNP (personal code) is your tax ID.
facts.L3_income_tax_foreign: PFA: 10% income tax, plus pension (CAS) and health (CASS) contributions above thresholds.
facts.L4_vat_gst: 21% VAT; exempt below 395,000 lei, and foreign B2B services don't count.
facts.L6_consumer_ecommerce: Online buyers can withdraw within 14 days.
facts.L7_incentives: Income norm: 10% tax on a fixed amount, if receipts stayed under €25,000.
facts.D1_id_document: Carte de identitate (ID card) or passport.

watch_out.text: Earning over €25,000 moves you to real-income taxation the next year.
CAS pension contributions are due once net income reaches 48,600 lei.
